mapper.sql: PROJECT_ID, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_NAME, DB_SCHEMA, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD_ENC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FRG_PROJECT_DB ( PROJECT_ID, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_NAME, DB_SCHEMA, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD_ENC ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{dbHost}, #{dbPort}, #{dbName}, #{dbSchema}, #{dbUsername}, #{dbPasswordEnc} ) ON CONFLICT (PROJECT_ID) DO UPDATE SET DB_HOST = EXCLUDED.DB_HOST, DB_PORT = EXCLUDED.DB_PORT, DB_NAME = EXCLUDED.DB_NAME, DB_SCHEMA = EXCLUDED.DB_SCHEMA, DB_USERNAME = EXCLUDED.DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD_ENC = EXCLUDED.DB_PASSWORD_ENC, MOD_DTM = now()
